policy: Do not infer replaceability from an algorithm name. Authentication and measurement have separate authorities.

purposes.authority: public measurements; signatures/MAC/server authorization remain required

blake3Parallel.scope: Native file measurement, updates at least 256 KiB; up to 4 independent leaf jobs and 1024 fixed CV slots; ordered canonical tree reduction. Small updates and resource-pressure fallback remain serial.
blake3Parallel.modes: Hash, keyed, derive, incremental and XOF share the same core; production file workers use unkeyed mode. Keyed mode protects server report storage; native derive-key creates one-shot Handoff content keys. Native startup KATs cover hash/keyed/derive.
blake3Parallel.ownership: Synchronous join of every started native worker before input reuse, release, or exception. Measurement budget checked before/after each bounded 1 MiB file block. No cancellation aborts a worker while borrowed input is live. Worker count and memory are bounded; a failed OS wait cannot safely release borrowed inputs, and drain time is not guaranteed under that failure.
blake3Parallel.validation: Compiled portable Pascal real-thread test plus pinned upstream independent mode/XOF comparison; actual Delphi/Windows runner validation must be performed separately.

purposes.keys: release approval and CI attestation MUST be different

purposes.note: Retain protocol algorithms and exact signed bytes; no bulk SHA-256 replacement.
Whole-request deadline and replay protection are independent of AEAD.
Not an SPKI pin. Unknown certificates never auto-accepted.

algorithms: KMAC256-512 with HKDF-SHA512 purpose-derived server key (integrity reports V3)
purposes.note: Preserve stored envelope versions and migrations. Fixed-size MACs use constant-time content comparisons.

integrityReportsV3.construction: KMAC256(HKDF-SHA512(server-secret, empty-salt, ASCII(GAME-SERVER-KMAC-KEY-V1\nGAME-INTEGRITY-REPORTS-STORE-V3), 32), SHA512(UTF8(JSON.stringify(data))), 512 bits, customization GAME-INTEGRITY-REPORTS-STORE-V3)
integrityReportsV3.migration: Existing V1/HMAC and V2/HMAC+BLAKE3 envelopes remain readable; next normal save writes V3. V3 requires all three MACs. Existing journal head and rollback checks remain required.

algorithms: existing random identifiers and server-side digest bindings
purposes.note: Identifiers do not substitute for possession of a secret or a purpose-bound signature.

purposes.binding: generation/endpoint/keyId/current/next/window; delivered after current TLS and AEAD checks. No independent detached-signature algorithm added. RAM-only antirollback, fresh-old-profile limitation explicit.

purposes.input: Exactly 32 fresh CNG random seed bytes, followed by exact authenticated transcript (1..8192 bytes); streamed without concatenated secret copy.
purposes.wire: Existing V3 RSA-OAEP wraps final derived key; AES-256-GCM/AAD/envelope layout/decrypt remain unchanged. No entropy amplification or extra authentication strength is claimed.
purposes.lifetime: Seed wiped immediately after derivation and on all failure paths; key wiped after CNG key creation and on cleanup; hasher state wiped on destruction.
purposes.validation: Pinned upstream independent deterministic vector, seed/transcript separation and input bounds via portable compiled cozy.HandoffKdfProbe. Actual Windows CNG round-trip remains a Windows test.
